rule: max_delta = (olostep_total - prod_budget) + margin; the olostep image must satisfy olostep_total <= prod_budget + max_delta
margin_reason: same 256 B allowance the prod budget keeps over its baseline (tools/check_esp8266_ram_budget.py MARGIN_BYTES)
source: CI build of the esp8266 and esp8266_olostep envs with the opt-in module present, measured with size -A; the module is built outside this repository
